cells.tense: The pattern is here now, and you are holding it plainly, with the pen.
cells.act: let yourself be drawn before you choose
cells.ask: Something's been pulling at you and you haven't answered it. Go toward it once — no case, no plan — and stay long enough to feel what the pull is doing.
cells.core:
You can see how a thing works, strip it to the mechanism, and stay available. Where nothing is attached to the pattern — no example, no person, no proof — you read it clean. You find the shape under the surface and you're still with what's actually happening, not only what you've worked out about it. Most people either miss the mechanism or get captured by it; here you do neither. Warmth and sharpness together carry further than the case built around either.

What this balance is free to feed next is the pull of what might be felt, before it's been chosen. Among what you've been working out, there's one you'd be sorry to lose if the analysis closed. Go toward that one first. Drawing near doesn't require a decision; the pattern will wait.

cells.verb: reading the mechanism under the surface and naming it before acting
cells.place: where pattern is seen with nothing attached to it — no story, no example, no one it's about

cells.tense: The pattern will be named and carried through before you know what it's for.
cells.act: decide it and act the same day, without explaining
cells.ask: Take a call you've been turning over — not the biggest, just the clearest. Make it and do the next concrete thing the same day. Don't talk it through with anyone first.
cells.core:
Where you see how things work, the reading runs out past the living. You find the shape, name it, and you're already moving to the next implication before the thing has landed. Close by, it reads like nothing gets to just be what it is for a minute. The pattern is meant to serve what it organizes. Here it has started organizing things that haven't happened yet.

Structure that's actually clear doesn't announce itself. It moves, and sense gathers around it. One call made today, carried without narration, meets that directly — not more thinking. Make the call, take the step, then let the world answer. The sharpness doesn't need proving; it's already reliable. The tightness isn't the pattern — it's what a reading does when it's asked to land before it can.

cells.tense: The pattern was read once, and the reading did not carry past the door.
cells.act: go deeper into the shared thing than comfort allows
cells.ask: Take the conversation you keep rehearsing alone and open it with the person it belongs to. Say the sentence you haven't let yourself say, and stay after it lands.
cells.core:
Where you used to see how things work, you've stopped looking. The pattern gets recognized away from the room it's actually in — worked over in private, turned around alone, and it doesn't cross back into the living of it. What you bring to people is the version you've already worked out, and the working out has replaced the contact. Reading is in you; here it's standing down.

Effort won't pull it back into place, and feeling pushed at a starved part won't carry either. The way back runs through people already connected to this — going deeper into the shared thing than is comfortable, leaving the form that no longer carries anything. Meaning moves between people when one stops performing it. Begin with the exchange you keep running alone. The pattern returns through the throat before it returns through the head.

cells.tense: The pattern is being drawn and you are not signing it, here in your own hand.
cells.act: gather the feelings that might be felt and look at them
cells.ask: When something pulls at you next, before you file it under chance, stop and gather everything it raises — the whole mess, no sorting. Look at what's there and pick nothing.
cells.core:
The reading is running — the pattern seen, the mechanism named, the conversation steered — and the credit is filed under circumstance. You'd say it just happened, or the person needed it said. Nobody put it there; you did, and the one who doesn't register it is you. Toward what's actually pulling you, the pull has also gone unnamed.

Here's the smaller thing underneath: gather what a thing makes you feel, and look at it before it gets organized. Not for anyone to see, not as proof. Notice yourself already moving toward it before you've decided. That move is the record of the pattern being yours. Keep what you notice. That's the part you've been leaving off the page.
